Service Consumner(user) Knowledgebase.question: What is Skill Trade?
Service Consumner(user) Knowledgebase.answer: Skill Trade is a service booking platform where users can book various services such as electricians, carpenters, plumbers, and more. It connects service providers with consumers to fulfill their needs efficiently.

Service Consumner(user) Knowledgebase.question: How do I book a service?
Service Consumner(user) Knowledgebase.answer: Click on 'Create Request' in the navbar, fill in the details of your request, and hit 'Submit'.

Service Consumner(user) Knowledgebase.question: What services do you provide?
Service Consumner(user) Knowledgebase.answer: We provide services such as electricians, carpenters, plumbers, painters, gardeners, mechanics, roofers, tilers, and more. You can explore all the services on our platform.

Service Consumner(user) Knowledgebase.question: Where can I view the created request?
Service Consumner(user) Knowledgebase.answer: Click on 'My Account' in the navbar, then click on 'View Request'. There you can see all your requests with their statuses.

Service Consumner(user) Knowledgebase.question: How can I change my password?
Service Consumner(user) Knowledgebase.answer: Click on 'My Account', then click on 'Profile'. There you will find the 'Password' tab where you can change your password.

Service Consumner(user) Knowledgebase.question: Where can I view request details?
Service Consumner(user) Knowledgebase.answer: You can view the details of your request on the 'View Request' page. Click on the 'View' button for the request you want to see details of.

Service Consumner(user) Knowledgebase.question: How do I get started?
Service Consumner(user) Knowledgebase.answer: Go to the 'Register' page and create an account by filling in the basic details as a service consumer.

Service Consumner(user) Knowledgebase.question: How can I (consumer) contact the service provider?
Service Consumner(user) Knowledgebase.answer: You can see which service provider or worker accepted your request on the 'Request Details' page. Click on the 'View Profile' button to find the contact information of the service provider.
